lines: Anthropic may already have a model more powerful than the Claude you're using today.
And this isn't just random Twitter hype.
The Claude lineup already goes past Opus, Sonnet and Haiku. Fable is real, and it's shipping.
Reports name others, like Mythos — and say newer versions are being tested internally.
The crazy part? Labs train the next generation long before you ever get access to it.
So while you're using today's best model… tomorrow's model may already exist.
